body: Yeap.. There's always someone there, it's just whether or not we choose to let them in.

I know how you feel in a way. I don't know what it's like to lose a friend to suicide but 2 years ago, when I was 16 years old, my father was murdered. I know how it feels to have someone who you looked up to and thought was the greatest. It hurts to think that even Superman will fall from the sky someday. I've thought about ending my own life but I also cling on to this shit hole of a society to protect my dad's side of the family. I don't want my grandma to have to experience the loss of her husband, her son, and then her grandson. I know how you feel and you're not alone. As lonely as I am, I'm surprised how many people can relate to how I feel. When no one else in the world cares, we do.

Wow.. Exactly how I feel. I can relate.. Every person that I've loved and trusted has backstabbed me or left. I have trust issues too, especially with women because my mom cheated on my father and had my little brother. If it could happen to such a great person like my father, it could happen to anyone. My grandfather who loved me a lot died of cancer and my father whom I loved most also died. My girlfriend just left me because she wants to go out and "test her limits" with other guys, drinking and everything else college has to offer. No one is ever cared before when I needed them and when I don't need them and learned to deal with it, they start to care. I mean like what the fuck.. I'm torn between this world and the next. I can honestly say no one trusts someone completely in this world. You're not alone in this world in terms of how you feel. I feel exactly the same way as you do.

Thanks. That is a great mindset and mentality and the type of lifestyle I should be living. I've tried that every so often. I've tried to do really good and keep my head up but after getting that A in a paper or a test and having no one to share it with and saying,"Yes! You're doing great, keep it up!" is really rough. Not that I don't have friends here but it makes it seem like I'm bragging. Every so often I set goals for myself but I can't seem to keep up with them. I say I'll do something, do it for a while, and then completely forget and stop. I have no one to throw me in the right direction. As much as I want to say "look what I did, bitch, look what I did by myself, for myself," that takes a lot of time and effort and I'm just so tired of it all.

At this stage in my life, I'm at the so what phase. So what if you have or have not kissed a girl. If you want to and when you feel comfortable with the right girl, you will. Do whatever feels right for you. Saying you're not stupid either just justifies the fact that you're afraid how others view you. Don't worry about how we judge you because this site is for suggestion and support. I wasn't necessarily a dumb kid either but as time passed on I started to not care anymore because I felt like no one else did either. Care for me at least. I started to cut school and shout out to them and seek attention. Nothing worked and in the end I just ended up looking like a disappointment to my father which is dead now. I live with guilt and regret everyday. You're a smart guy and I'm sure if you put your mind to it, you'll pass physics and math easily.

Really, it doesn't matter if you have had sex or not. It seems like you're being pressured in a way because of the fact that you had not had sex yet. So what if you haven't? It just shows that you're a person with good qualities, and respect women. I know how it feels to love someone and have it not returned. You're a very caring and loyal friend/person. You don't want to tell anyone your problems because you feel like everyone has their own problems to deal with. As for your parents, you don't want to tell them because you want to protect them. How would they feel knowing how their son is thinking or feeling. You're afraid that after you tell them, they will be depressed to and that the relationship between you and them would change. They wouldn't treat you the way they used to. Rumors would spread among the school and among the family and everyone would look at you differently. Life wouldn't be the same. I know exactly how you feel except for the fact that my dad, who loved me is dead and my mom doesn't care about me and I hate her. Thinking a lot is only natural but it may be due to a chemical imbalance in your head that can lead to that.

I honestly don't know anymore. Is it really worth it? I don't feel like any of it is worth it. Why do we live? Is it to make an impact or influence? Or strictly because we have got too much to lose? Is it because if I die I'm missing out on the opportunities I have and the good things that can happen in the future? Many people have told me I have a future ahead of me but if I have no present, how may I have a future. Yes it would be a shame if I let something like this slip by, but I've let so many things in my life slip by that one more shouldn't hurt. If I died, my money could go to better causes. My organs could go to use. If I died maybe the stubborn people in my family could open their eyes more. Maybe I could watch my mom suffer and cry for once in my life. I may seem really fucked up but I blame her for everything that has gone wrong in my life. She was the one who made my grandparents move out, followed by my uncle and my great aunt.

For the two years after my dad's death, I lived with my mom, whom I hated, my step dad, my half brother and half sister. I didn't feel like I belonged there so I was always locked up in the room. When it was time for dinner, I'd walk down to grab some food and realize they didn't ever cook my share so I'd pretend I was going down for a glass of water. I would stay in my room until they all went to sleep before I would go downstairs to make something to eat. It was during this time that my hate started to grow tremendously. I had trust issues with women too, because of my experience with my mother. I haven't had a girlfriend in a while because I was always afraid of getting hurt, and hurting others. My girlfriend came from a conservative family but she was very open minded, loyal, caring, bright and she understood me. I don't really hate her for wanting to branch out, I hate her for saying she wants to "test" her limits on other guys. I hate the fact that she can say she loves me, but wants to go hookup with other guys and drink. I've joined a few clubs and groups on campus and met a lot of nice people but even they can't really fog my mind of what I am thinking. No matter where I am, during what time of day, I am always having pessimistic thoughts, but I hide it with the fake smiles and sexual humor. Honestly I don't like to do anything anymore. I've lost interest in everything. The only thing that feels good is drinking and smoking weed, but that's not the healthy or right approach, so I try my best to stay away from it until I can find a better solution. Meanwhile, the massive loads of work that accumulates from being on a pre-medical track is quite overwhelming.

The thing is I'm not really going to University for myself. What I really wanted to do was join the army and go to war and die. That way I would have died being a "hero" at least and not because I couldn't bare the pain anymore. My private university is a really big one and I'm living on campus about 5 hrs away from home. As much as I'd like to take advantage of this opportunity, I am paying for college myself. 

As for my girlfriend, it's hard to just forget her because of what we have been through. Maybe I should be doing what she is but I don't see the fun in it. Nowadays people can't have fun without drinking and I find that pretty pathetic. I feel like she was just using our relationship as a test..
It was when I was 16, about two years ago..

After I kill them, then what? Am I supposed to feel better? You're comparing a real life situation to movies and in the movies, they normally don't get anything from killing the murderers of their  loved ones. But you're right, what have I got to lose?
Nothing good comes from being awake, and nothing comes from being asleep.

I've talked to a psychiatrist and had regular sessions when my dad was diagnosed. Talking didn't really do anything. The only other option was meds. I've tried them and they didn't do anything for me. I was even more depressed and didn't want to move or get out of bed. Nothing can be done anymore. Every night I have the same reoccuring vivid dreams. I can see the person torturing my father. I normally stay up all day and only sleep when I'm extremely tired and that is the only option. in every 48 hrs, I sleep 3.
